14.16.title: Maximum Unambiguous Range of Pulse Radar
14.16.title_cn: 脉冲雷达最大无模糊距离
14.16.description: A pulse radar has a pulse repetition frequency $f_r = 1/T_r$. Determine the maximum unambiguous range of the radar. (Range ambiguity occurs when the round-trip time of a return pulse is greater than the pulse repetition time, so it becomes unclear as to whether a given return pulse belongs to the last transmitted pulse or some earlier transmitted pulse.)
14.16.description_cn: 一部脉冲雷达的脉冲重复频率为 $f_r = 1/T_r$。确定该雷达的最大无模糊距离。（当回波脉冲的往返时间大于脉冲重复周期时，就会产生距离模糊，因为无法确定某个回波脉冲是属于最近发射的脉冲还是更早发射的脉冲。）

steps.title: Range Measurement Principle
steps.explanation: Round-trip time $\Delta t$ corresponds to twice the distance
steps.explanation_cn: 往返时间 $\Delta t$ 对应两倍距离

steps.title: Condition for Unambiguous Range
steps.explanation: To avoid ambiguity, return pulse must arrive before next pulse is transmitted
steps.explanation_cn: 为避免模糊，回波必须在下一个脉冲发射之前到达

steps.title: Maximum Unambiguous Range Formula
steps.explanation: Substitute maximum round-trip time into range equation
steps.explanation_cn: 将最大往返时间代入距离公式

14.16.note: Range ambiguity occurs when $R > R_{\text{unamb}}$. Higher PRF reduces unambiguous range but improves update rate. Some radars use PRF staggering to extend unambiguous range.
14.16.note_cn: 当 $R > R_{\text{unamb}}$ 时产生距离模糊。较高的脉冲重复频率会减小无模糊距离，但能提高更新率。某些雷达采用脉冲重复频率参差技术来扩展无模糊距离。
